data.narrative:
Newcleo is a Series B nuclear energy company that has raised $755M to date. The broader nuclear energy sector comprises 3 public comparables (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, and Valar Atomics.

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method, given insufficient depth in same-stage or adjacent-stage nuclear peers to support a robust peer-median calculation. Applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $755M raised proxy yields a median implied valuation of $1.4B. This method reflects the company's capital intensity and progression trajectory within frontier nuclear development.

The peer-median approach was not applied; while four nuclear sector comparables exist, filtering for same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints yielded fewer than three usable observations, insufficient for meaningful median triangulation. Using an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable heterogeneity bias.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.2B to $1.6B, centered on $1.4B. Key uncertainties include the applicability of the 1.9x stage multiplier to nuclear-specific capital and regulatory dynamics, and the absence of granular public comp trading multiples at comparable development stages. The narrow peer set constrains confidence in any single method; validation against future funding outcomes and sector milestone achievements will be critical.
